input_markdown:
# HTTP
## Basics
HTTP is an application layer protocol used for client server communication on the web and in many APIs.
## Request Structure
- method
- path
- headers
- optional body
## Response Structure
- status code
- headers
- optional body
## Common Methods
- `GET`
- `POST`
- `PUT`
- `PATCH`
- `DELETE`
## Transport
HTTP typically runs on top of [TCP](/TCP and UDP.md) because ordered and reliable byte streams are important for request and response delivery.
In production environments, HTTP is frequently secured with [TLS](/TLS.md) and distributed across backends with [Load Balancing](/Load Balancing.md).
## Common Status Code Groups
- `2xx`: success
- `3xx`: redirection
- `4xx`: client error
- `5xx`: server error
